title: Parse the numbers out of Acme's vacation policy
smoke: parse_vacation_policy('- Full-time employees receive 14 paid vacation days in their first year of employment.')
spec: Implement parse_vacation_policy(text: str) -> dict. The text is a version of Acme's vacation policy (data/acme/hr_policies.md): markdown bullets with the same sentences, but the numbers change between versions and the bullets may come in any order.
Return a dict with exactly these keys (int values unless noted):
- first_year_days: from 'Full-time employees receive N paid vacation days in their first year of employment.'
- yearly_increment: from 'From the second year, the allowance grows by N day(s) per year of service, up to a maximum of M days.'
- max_days: M from the same sentence.
- carryover_days: from 'Up to N unused days may be carried over to the next calendar year.'
- carryover_expiry: from 'Carried-over days expire on <Month> <day>.', as a 'MM-DD' string, e.g. 'March 31' -> '03-31'.
- notice_weeks: from 'Vacation requests of 3 days or more must be submitted in the HR portal at least N week(s) in advance ...' (N is the weeks, not the 3 days).
- shutdown_days: from '... N vacation day(s) is/are deducted automatically.'
Singular and plural forms both appear ('1 day', '2 days'). If a sentence is missing, its key(s) map to None. Never raise.
